limited_hint: Messages exposes chat names but not message contents to scripting. Read the open conversation window instead (read_app_window).

actions.description: Chats visible in Messages: display name and chat id. Message contents are not readable through scripting; use read_app_window on the open conversation for that.
script: set cname to name of c
if cname is missing value then set cname to ""
set out to out & cname & fsep & (id of c) & rsep
if counter is greater than or equal to {{limit}} then return out
